title: R2-SEC4: Chat.receiptSharing missing inline semantics
description: wrl.22: Chat.receiptSharing (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:441-442) is defined only as 'Per-Chat override of the account-level PresenceStatus.receiptSharing preference (see presence-status). When present, this value takes precedence over the account-level setting for this Chat only. When absent, the account-level preference applies.' The definition does not state what false means — a reader must follow the cross-reference to PresenceStatus.receiptSharing to discover that false suppresses outbound read receipts. PresenceStatus.receiptSharing (line 784-785) provides the normative definition: 'When false, this account does not send read receipts to peers.' Suggested fix: add a one-sentence inline gloss to Chat.receiptSharing, e.g., 'When false, the server suppresses outbound Peer/receipt calls for this Chat; when true, the account-level preference applies unchanged.' This avoids requiring implementors to follow two hops to understand the field's effect.
close_reason: Opinion: Chat.receiptSharing has cross-reference to presence-status
